name: Operational Risk
description: Operational loss events, risk and control self-assessments, key risk indicators, and issues.

dimensions.name: event_type
dimensions.description: Basel event type (e.g., external fraud; execution, delivery and process management)

metrics.name: gross_loss
metrics.description: Gross operational loss amount recognized in the period

metrics.name: net_loss
metrics.description: Gross loss minus recoveries and insurance

metrics.name: event_count
metrics.description: Loss events recognized in the period

metrics.name: open_issues
metrics.description: Open audit or control issues at a point in time

metrics.name: kri_breaches
metrics.description: Key risk indicator threshold breaches in the period

conventions.rule: Loss events have occurrence, discovery, and accounting dates; state which one periods are based on.
Loss data has a collection threshold; small events below it are excluded.

caveats.text: Operational losses are fat-tailed; a single event can dominate a period, so show median and count alongside totals.

chart_conventions.rule: Show losses by event type as a sorted bar with event counts beside amounts.

review.notes: Drafted from public, general industry conventions; not yet reviewed by a named domain owner.
